Snag last time, y'all: the tag number matched mine, but the pair hung all wrong on me (returning them cost gas money). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Not climbing that switchback twice, since I'm a broke student. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
